rationale: The workflow already implements the key evidence-supported optimizations that apply to its structure: P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is present via the top-level concurrency block with cancel-in-progress: true, and P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is present via fail-fast: true on every matrix job. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE dependency caching is already applied for Rust (Swatinem/rust-cache@v2 with cache-bin: false, caching dependency state rather than build outputs) and Node.js (actions/cache@v6 for the Yarn cache). No other pattern from the evidence is safely applicable as a minimal workflow-only change without risking reduced coverage, adding unsupported actions, or introducing unrelated modifications. Scheduled-workflow, Bazel, test-selection, history-based, and environment-reuse patterns either lack preconditions in this repository or fall outside workflow-yaml scope.
